test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which sport are arrows used?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Archery.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ****A**rchery**, is a sport involving shooting arrows with a bow, either at an inanimate target or in hunting.
 
• An arrow is a pointed projectile that is shot with a bow. 
 
• It predates recorded history and is common to most cultures. 
 
• A sport that exudes the values of patience, precision, and concentration, **archery** has evolved into a global sport in modern times. 
 
• It is defined as the act of using bows and arrows, the word 'archery' comes from the Latin word 'arcus', which meant bow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shooting games **involve shooting** enemies or objects in** multiplayer and single-player environments**. These games often test your **reflexes, spatial awareness, and aiming skills. **
 
• **Fencing** is a group of three related **combat sports**. The three disciplines in modern fencing are the foil, winning points are made through the weapon's contact with an opponent.
 
• Boxing is **a sport that involves two athletes fighting each other, trying to punch their opponent with padded gloves on their fists**. 
 
• Fights usually last 3-12 rounds, with each round usually lasting three minutes.
